selected_over.reason: Official semantic documentation is strong, but the pinned public repository exposes less direct core resolver implementation evidence for the settings/instruction surfaces selected for deterministic conformance.

Official rules documentation exists, but the pinned public repository does not expose the core rules/config resolver implementation needed for source-backed conformance; some rule applicability is agent-decided.

rules.summary: The default instructional context filename is GEMINI.md.
rules.supported_boundary: Pinned docs/source agree that GEMINI.md is the built-in default context filename when context.fileName does not override it.
rules.unresolved_boundary: This claim does not cover import recursion, JIT activation, or trust-dependent loading.

rules.summary: The documented global context file is ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md.
rules.supported_boundary: Static research covers the documented global context location ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and its discovery as a source.
rules.unresolved_boundary: Whether later runtime/JIT context changes the complete active instruction set remains outside this rule.

rules.summary: Workspace and ancestor context files are discovered hierarchically and concatenated in documented order.
rules.supported_boundary: Static research covers initial hierarchical discovery of ancestor/workspace context files within the documented traversal boundary.
rules.unresolved_boundary: Descendant JIT context and memory-import recursion are excluded from this supported claim.

rules.summary: JIT context discovery is documented, but the complete future active set depends on runtime file/directory access and cannot be asserted by static pre-session inspection without additional explicit inputs.
rules.supported_boundary: The existence of JIT discovery as an upstream semantic is evidenced; descendant files are treated as discoverable/conditional rather than pre-session active.
rules.unresolved_boundary: The complete future active set depends on runtime file/directory access and trusted-root inputs not available to static pre-session inspection.

rules.summary: context.fileName can replace the default context filename with a string or configured list of names.
rules.supported_boundary: Static research covers context.fileName as a string or list that changes candidate context filenames in pinned source/docs.
rules.unresolved_boundary: All interactions between filename lists, imports, hierarchy traversal, and JIT access traces are not yet asserted.

rules.summary: For settings-file values, schema defaults are followed by system defaults, user settings, trusted workspace settings, then system settings as overrides.
rules.supported_boundary: Settings-file merge precedence is limited to schema defaults, system defaults, user settings, trusted workspace settings, then system settings overrides.
rules.unresolved_boundary: Environment-derived values, CLI argument precedence, remote admin controls, and every setting-specific merge strategy are outside this rule.

rules.summary: The settings merge excludes workspace settings when the supplied workspace trust state is false.
rules.supported_boundary: Given an explicit untrusted workspace state, workspace settings are excluded from the settings merge.
rules.unresolved_boundary: How the default trust-enabled setting is chosen when no explicit value is present is tracked separately and remains unresolved.

rules.summary: Pinned documentation and implementation paths disagree about the default value/behavior of security.folderTrust.enabled.
rules.supported_boundary: No default value is promoted as supported while pinned official documentation conflicts with the pinned settings schema/runtime call path.
rules.unresolved_boundary: The effective default is disputed by docs versus schema/source; Codex Scope must not infer enabled or disabled for an omitted setting until the discrepancy is resolved or bounded away.

rules.summary: The trust implementation reports trust provenance as IDE, file, environment, or unknown.
rules.supported_boundary: Pinned trust code exposes trust provenance categories IDE, file, environment, or unknown/undefined.
rules.unresolved_boundary: This rule does not claim every precedence interaction among those sources beyond paths explicitly evidenced by pinned source/tests.

discrepancies.summary: Trusted Folders docs say disabled by default; configuration reference says enabled=true by default; trustedFolders.ts and config.ts also use different nullish defaults in different call paths.

known_unknowns: Exact deterministic boundary between initial hierarchical context and later JIT context for arbitrary future tool-access traces.
Memory import recursion, trust-root, and error semantics are not yet promoted into the supported research subset.
Interaction between context.fileName lists and every hierarchy/JIT path needs fixture-level confirmation before adapter implementation.
Automatic local Gemini CLI version detection is not part of the research spike.
MCP, hooks, extensions, custom commands, policy engine, and model/runtime behavior remain outside the proposed initial adapter subset.
